name: Reporting Message Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the status of a whole message processing.

ACTC.name: Accepted Technical Validation
ACTC.definition: Message has passed syntactical validation but further validations have not been completed yet.

PART.name: Partially Accepted
PART.definition: Message has been partially accepted. A number of transactions have been accepted, whereas another number of transactions have not yet been accepted.

RCVD.name: Received
RCVD.definition: Message has been received but not processed yet.

RMDR.name: Reminder
RMDR.definition: Reminder of a non received message.

WARN.name: Warning
WARN.definition: Message has been accepted with warnings.

INCF.name: Incorrect Filename
INCF.definition: File containing the report has an incorrect filename.

CRPT.name: Corrupted File
CRPT.definition: File containing the report is corrupted.
